title: Orchestrator runs the wave runner once; its JSON summary shows every task verified and merged
plan:
# Wave 1 — mdlint workspace split

Executed with the wave runner (`node scripts/wave-runner.mjs --plan plan.md`): it spawns one agent per task in its own worktree, runs an independent supervisor per task, and merges only tasks whose verdict is ok=true. Its JSON summary is the record of the wave.

## T1 — Extract parser into crates/mdlint-parser
must_run:
- `cargo test -p mdlint-parser`

## T2 — Move rules into crates/mdlint-rules
must_run:
- `cargo test -p mdlint-rules`
- `cargo clippy -p mdlint-rules -- -D warnings`

## T3 — Thin CLI crate over parser + rules
must_run:
- `cargo test -p mdlint-cli`
- `cargo run -p mdlint-cli -- --check fixtures/sample.md`
